title: Derived constant realization in fixed coordinates
statement: Let X be any scheme, B any commutative ring in its universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet, psi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism and W an X-etale chart. For every small B-derived object F, the fixed-coordinate chart restriction [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction] of derived scalar extension along psi of its constant realization [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data] is isomorphic to the constant module-valued complex on W.left of its coefficient universe lift [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-etale-level-data]. No finite ring, boundedness, cover or nonempty chart is assumed.

proof.text: Restriction along psi and its inverse are inverse exact equivalences; the sectionwise restriction-composition isomorphisms give the unit and counit. On derived categories, uniqueness of left adjoints identifies actual derived scalar extension with the inverse equivalence. Thus extension followed by restriction cancels.

The sheafification unit induces a natural map from the fixed-module constant sheaf to restriction of koszulConstantFunctor. It is invertible by the locally bijective scalar unit. Naturality is the naturality of the module-sheafification unit, checked after precomposition with toSheafify.

Whisker the constant comparison by localization, which preserves constant sheaves. Apply the exact-derived composition and natural-isomorphism APIs, retaining the small coefficient lift. This is valid for unbounded complexes.

theorem finiteCoefficient_derived_constant_coordinates
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (ψ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hψ : IsIso ψ) (W : X.Etale)
    (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} B)) :
    Nonempty ((finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R ψ W).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((completedAdicDerivedChange X ψ).obj ((finitePerfectAdicDerivedConstant X B).obj F)) ≅
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W.left)
        (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((finitePerfectAdicAlgebraLift B).obj F))
